name: Hazor
overview: Hazor was a significant fortified city in the territory of Naphtali and also appears as a city in southern Judah, highlighting its strategic and regional importance. Scripture records that Hazor was the head of many kingdoms, and under Joshua's leadership, Israel decisively defeated and destroyed the city, burning it completely as a demonstration of God's judgment against its kings and inhabitants. This destruction was unique among the cities conquered, emphasizing God's sovereignty and the fulfillment of His commands through Israel's conquest.
